text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon, who has been in a bit of a slump lately, invited me to go make a prayer with her—
choice_data_list: It's surprising to see you relying on divine intervention.
It's surprising to see you relying on divine intervention.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? It's nothing like that.
Praying isn't gonna fix a slump anyway.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Taking care of your own business is just common sense.
I just wanted to keep my spirits high, is all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: So, I thought I'd make a promise with the man upstairs.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"That's right. You gotta swear not to rely on the gods,
and make things happen with your own two hands."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Even when it's tough, I won't run away.
I'll train harder than anyone and definitely win!" ...right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: If it's a promise with God, there's no way you can break it, right?
choice_data_list: I promise I'll make you win no matter what!
I promise I'll make sure you win too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's go pay our respects right away.
(CLANG-CLANG! CLAP-CLAP!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Just watch me, God!
No matter how strong my opponent is, I will definitely win!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Phew, like this?
I feel pretty refreshed now, but—hm?
(Rustle rustle—)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I wondered what all the noise was about... It's just Ama-san, huh...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Brian?
What are you doing in a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: It's nothing, just some self-practice...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: See ya.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Extra training, huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Brian is out there running, and here I am...
What am I even spacing out for?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I'm wide awake now!
I'm gonna sprint all the way back!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Meeting Brian here might just be
part of God's divine plan too!"

All fired up, Hishi Amazon seems
to have gotten her usual groove back!

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meeeeeooow.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, well if it isn't a kitty.
Aren't you a cutie—

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Bnyanyanyanya-ッ!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: !? M-My handkerchief...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hey, hold it right there!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... Unbelievable...
To think that I couldn't even catch a cat...
Perhaps because she wasn't feeling well, Hishi Amazon was completely at the mercy of the cat...
